note: The input projection definition string controls the bytes that pj_init_plus_ctx will copy and tokenize into projection parameters.
The controlled +proj=geos, +ellps=WGS84, and +h=0 tokens become argv entries for pj_init_ctx.
The first controlled token is inserted into the projection parameter linked list used by later parameter lookups.
The remaining controlled tokens, including h=0, are added to the same parameter list.
The geos projection setup is invoked with a PJ object whose params contain the input-controlled h=0 value.
The controlled h parameter is parsed into Q->h as 0; safe continuation requires Q->h to be greater than 0, but the error path does not return after destroying P.
The invalid h value causes pj_default_destructor to free the PJ object and its opaque geos state while execution continues in the same function.
The function reads P->phi0 after P has been freed by the previous destructor call, producing the heap-use-after-free read.
